meta.title: Electius — Secure, verifiable online voting for organizations
meta.description: Run your organization’s entire election in one place — anonymous ballots, verifiable receipts and a permanent audit trail. Free for elections up to 50 voters.

hero.title: Secure Electronic Voting System For Organizations
hero.subtitle: Run the entire election — from setup to anonymous ballots, certified results and a permanent audit trail — in one place your members can actually trust.

problem.title: Running a vote shouldn’t feel like a liability.
problem.subtitle: Most organizations are stuck between tools that were never built for elections — and systems too heavy to actually use.

paper.title: Paper & email ballots
paper.body: Manual counting, lost envelopes and no real anonymity. One disputed result and the whole election is in question.

forms.title: Google Forms & survey tools
forms.body: Every response is tied to an identity, anyone with access can edit results, and there’s nothing a voter can verify.

enterprise.title: Enterprise election systems
enterprise.body: Powerful, but priced and engineered for governments — weeks of setup and a budget no association wants to defend.

story.title: One home for the entire election — not five tools stitched together.
story.p1: We kept watching organizations run consequential votes on paper, email and spreadsheets — or pay for systems so complex they needed a consultant to start.
story.p2a: There was no accessible platform that covered the
story.p2b: — preparation, voting, results and archiving — with real guarantees of anonymity, integrity and an audit trail you can hand to any member who asks.

quotes.quote: Our annual board election used to take a committee three days to count. With Electius results were certified the moment voting closed — and nobody questioned them.
quotes.name: Renata Kovač

quotes.quote: Student turnout jumped because voting took two minutes on a phone. The verifiable receipt ended every ‘was my vote counted?’ email overnight.
quotes.name: Daniel Mendez

quotes.quote: The full audit trail satisfied our legal review on the first pass. Every resolution we’ve passed since lives in one searchable archive.
quotes.name: Sofia Oduya

features.title: Everything an election needs, nothing it doesn’t.
features.subtitle: Built around the guarantees that make a result hold up: anonymity, integrity, and a record anyone can check.

verifiability.title: End-to-end verifiability
verifiability.body: Every voter gets a cryptographic receipt to confirm their ballot was recorded and counted — without ever revealing how they voted.

anonymity.title: Truly anonymous ballots
anonymity.body: Identity and choice are separated by design. Electius can prove the count is right while making it impossible to trace a ballot to a person.

results.title: Results the moment voting closes
results.body: Turnout and the full tally are certified the instant the election ends — no spreadsheets, no manual count, no waiting. Live results during voting are a Pro feature.

audit.title: Complete audit trail
audit.body: Every action is timestamped and tamper-evident, producing a documentation pack ready for legal review or a contested result.

setup.title: Set it up once
setup.body: Build the election once and schedule it — Electius mints every magic link, sends the invitations and certifies the result. Automatic 24-hour voter reminders are a Pro feature.

archive.title: One place for every vote
archive.body: Past and present elections live in a single searchable archive — so the record of every decision is always one click away.

pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when it counts.
pricing.subtitle: Two plans, no hidden fees. A real 50-voter election runs free.
pricing.compare: Established platforms charge from €90 for an election that size. On Electius it costs nothing.

pricing.betaNotice: Beta — every feature is currently open to all organizations. The pricing below is planned for our official launch.
pricing.footnoteVat: Billing is per organization. Prices exclude VAT where applicable.

items.a: Every person on the voter roster of a single election — whether or not they end up casting a ballot. A 40-person roster counts as 40 voters even if 25 vote.

items.q: What happens when my election is bigger than my plan?
items.a: The limit is per election. During the beta there are no limits — every feature is open to all organizations. At official launch the plan is: up to 50 voters free, up to 500 with Pro.

items.q: What happens to my elections if I cancel?
items.a: Nothing is lost. Your account returns to Free and every archive record — root hash, result and PDF report — stays available forever. Only the Pro retention benefit ends: bulky audit proofs follow the Free rule and are pruned 12 months after each election.
No. Electius is in beta — every feature is open to all organizations and nothing is charged. The prices shown are planned for our official launch.

The Free plan stays — a real election of up to 50 voters will still cost nothing. During the beta every feature is open to you, Pro included; when billing starts, Free returns to the limits in the table above. We will announce that before anything changes.
